## Review checklist

- [ ] Public Apple APIs and original/licensed assets; no private data or signing material.
- [ ] Demo remains labeled and isolated; hardware claims are separately supported.
- [ ] Meaningful behavior changes have full XCTest/XCUITest evidence in docs/VALIDATION.md.
- [ ] Generated settings were changed in the generator and regenerated deterministically, if applicable.
- [ ] AGENTS.md commit-time policy was followed.
